resources.string: Slide one finger up, then turn left or right. Release to open a vertical Dock near your finger. Scroll vertically for more apps, or pull the Dock sideways again to open widgets.
Try the motion in the area below
Move up, turn sideways, then release
Avoid the screen edges. This gesture may also scroll the app underneath. When the gesture is unavailable, use the edge handles instead.
Cannot reach the settings? With StellaShell set as your Home app, press Home three times quickly (within 1.5 seconds) to open settings.
Got it: a vertical Dock opens near your finger
